sources.title: BlockFusion wins approval to reopen bitcoin mine on Frontier Avenue

profile.campus_note: One of 11 buildings OpenStreetMap contributors have mapped under this name in this locality, numbered west to east.
profile.research_note: Session 2026-09-03: local press names the operating entity "Northeast Data LLC" doing business as BlockFusion. All 10 OSM nodes for this name sit within ~250m of each other on the same Frontier Avenue industrial site and resolve to the same address via Nominatim reverse geocode; treated as one multi-building campus, not 10 distinct facilities.

reading.body:
BlockFusion's Niagara Falls campus shows 0 MW of tracked power capacity, meaning either no public data exists for this facility or it operates below reporting thresholds.

The site sits on industrial land in Niagara Falls, a region with historically cheap hydroelectric power and a legacy of energy-intensive manufacturing. Local approval for the facility came in 2026. The research notes indicate a multi-building campus operating under the name Northeast Data LLC, with at least ten mapped structures clustered within 250 meters on the same Frontier Avenue property. The operator is tracked as BlockFusion.

The absence of a megawatt figure prevents any assessment of this facility's role in AI compute supply. It may be a small installation, a facility that does not report publicly, or a site where power allocation data remains unavailable. Without capacity data, the binding constraint framework cannot yet quantify how this location contributes to or competes for grid resources in New York State.

The research status is marked exhausted, meaning no additional public sources on power consumption or buildout timeline were found. Future updates would require either direct operator disclosure or regulatory filings specific to this site.
